title: ZeroWorlds
description: ZeroWorlds is a private vanilla Minecraft server with minimal enhancements, focused on a mature community, long-term gameplay, economy, and RP elements. 🌍⛏️
body:
ZeroWorlds is a private vanilla Minecraft server designed for players who want a calm, long-term survival experience without the chaos of typical public servers. The project focuses on preserving the original Minecraft gameplay while adding a few carefully selected features that improve convenience and depth without breaking vanilla mechanics. 

The server runs on Java Edition versions 1.20.1–1.21.x and supports both licensed and cracked clients. The project has existed since August 9, 2022, and has built a stable community over time rather than being a short-term server launch. 

A key idea behind ZeroWorlds is community and quality of players. Access to the server is private and requires an application, which helps filter out griefers and toxic players. Most players are Russian-speaking and around 15–30 years old, and they usually enjoy long projects such as building cities, farms, creating stories, and participating in role-play events. 

The server includes several features that expand the vanilla experience while keeping it balanced. For example, it has a player-driven economy with its own currency and shops, role-play systems such as governments, laws, quests, and events, and more than 1000 custom achievements. Voice communication through PlasmoVoice and player animations through EmoteCraft are also part of the gameplay, making interaction between players more lively. 

Overall, ZeroWorlds is not just a survival server but a living world with its own culture, events, and community history. Players come not only to gather resources but to build something meaningful, gain recognition in the community, and take part in a long-term shared world. 

If summarized in one idea: ZeroWorlds is vanilla Minecraft for players who treat the game as a long-term project rather than a short casual session.
